edits.old:
## After the wedding: the bride's return visit

### 7. The return visit (hui men)

Traditionally the bride went home again a few days after the wedding. The community summary says that historically, about three days after the wedding, the couple visited the bride's family home, where she was received as a guest. <!-- fact_32 --> The National Museum of Singapore describes san zhao hui men as a traditional element of a Chinese wedding in which the bride returns home with the groom on the third day; the garment it holds for the visit dates from 1952. <!-- fact_26 -->

In Singapore, the National Library Board says the bride now returns home on the wedding day, and the tea ceremony is performed for her parents and relatives then. <!-- fact_22 --> Historically, the groom presented a whole roast pig to his in-laws; the meat was shared among the bride's relatives, and the head and tail were returned to the groom for "a good beginning and end". <!-- fact_23 -->
